ModMetaData.name: Armor Integrity (Prototype v2.2)
ModMetaData.author: PhillipFrei
ModMetaData.description: Prototype v2.2. One hit wears exactly one outermost armor layer. All core armor checks use Sharp. The single Battered bar now follows the exact armor layer that actually absorbed the most recent armor hit instead of trying to infer a layer from all worn apparel.
